messages:
Nia: Quick update  Liam wants to transition from full-time to 1099 contractor for a 6-month engagement starting 2026-12-01. This is a change-in-employment status, so we need an offboard + contractor onboarding checklist. Can we outline timing for access changes, equity repurchase, benefits cutoff, and device handling?
Liam: Correct. Im staying on for the project but as an external consultant. Ill sign the SOW, but I need to keep access to a closed-source integration repo for the next 3 months. Happy to follow any security controls.
Zoe-IT: This is slightly different than a pure resignation. Proposed plan:
- 2026-11-30 09:00: set Slack "Away - transitioning to contractor" and block calendar
- 2026-11-30 12:00: remove full-time org roles (payroll/benefits groups) in Okta but create contractor role with limited perms
- 2026-11-30 12:05: change GitHub org membership from "member" to "outside_collaborator" on required repos (read+PR rights only)
- 2026-11-30 12:15: rotate any personal infra keys and create scoped deploy token for the integration repo with 30-day expiry
- 2026-11-30 12:30: restrict access to internal dashboards and set data redaction where PII present
Commands I'll run (audit attached to JIRA):
```
# Okta change
oktactl update-user --user liam --remove-groups "employees,full-time-benefits" --add-groups "contractors,consultants"
# GitHub change
gh api --method PATCH /orgs/redwood/memberships/liam -f role=none
gh api --method PUT /repos/redwood/integration/collaborators/liam -f permission=push
# Vault: revoke personal keys & create scoped token
vault kv delete secret/users/liam
vault token create -policy="integration-limited" -ttl=720h -display-name="liam-contract-token"
```
Asha-HR: Benefits/equity notes:
- COBRA will be offered; COBRA notice queued for 2026-12-01. Benefits termination date in system: 2026-12-15.
- Equity: since this is departure of employment, we'll run the repurchase/termination clauses per the equity plan. I will send Liam the equity FAQ and the board-approved repurchase timeline. Repurchase paperwork must be returned within 30 days to avoid auto-repurchase.
- Payroll: Last full-time paycheck processes on 2026-12-05; any taxable benefits adjustments will be reconciled. As a contractor you won't receive PTO payout unless covered by the agreement.
Carlos-Security: Security checklist:
- Snapshot active sessions and export auth logs 90 days back before performing role changes.
- Make contractor access timeboxed (30/60/90-day tokens) and require MFA and IP allowlist where possible.
- If Liam needs access to client PII for the integration, we need a signed DPA amendment and an approved data access request from product.
asset-bot: Reminder  please complete device status in Offboard Inventory. Liam, mark laptop retention preference (return / keep as contractor) by 2026-11-28.
offboard-bot: Create JIRA ticket OFFBOARD-CONV-5581 and attach HR+IT flows. Template: OFFBOARD-CONVERSION. https://jira.redwood.com/browse/OFFBOARD-CONV-5581
Liam: Id like to keep the laptop for contractor work and will sign an asset agreement. I'll review the equity paperwork when Asha sends it. I do need scoped push on integration repo for deployment testing, but no access to production.
Zoe-IT: Noted  we'll issue a scoped deploy token with explicit denials for prod and a 30-day TTL. We'll also register the contractor token in the secrets manager with an automated expiry job.
Carlos-Security: Once Zoe posts the token ID, Ill run an entitlement review and ensure no lingering prod roles. Also require Liam to confirm personal device encryption and corporate VPN MFA.
Asha-HR: Sent COBRA notice draft and equity FAQ to Liam via email. Also scheduled a short offboarding call 2026-11-29 11:00 to sign paperwork and confirm SOW start.
Liam: Received the emails. I signed the SOW and uploaded it to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/handovers/liam-sow.pdf. Put me on the contractor group on Okta with the agreed repo perms.
Zoe-IT: Completed Okta role swap and GitHub outside_collaborator change at 2026-11-30T12:08Z. Created token id tok-ct-772 (30d TTL) and registered it in Vault. Audit snippets attached to OFFBOARD-CONV-5581.
Carlos-Security: Entitlement audit done  no prod access. Exported 90-day auth logs and DPA amendment uploaded to JIRA.
Asha-HR: Equity repurchase paperwork acknowledged and timeline started. COBRA notice sent. Payroll processed final FTE paycheck.
asset-bot: Asset agreement signed and laptop retention recorded. Note: contractor must return device at contract end or renew agreement.
Nia: Closing loop  OFFBOARD-CONV-5581 moved to In Review. Please add any outstanding artifacts or approvals. Thanks everyone for the smooth transition. :handshake:
